CITY OF LA VERNE
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  AGENDA

Jason Simison, Chairperson  City Hall Council Chambers

Thomas Allison, Commissioner  (909) 596-8706
Jeremy Conrad, Commissioner  www.cityoflaverne.org

  Wednesday, March 8, 2023 - 6:30 p.m.
  City Hall Council Chambers
  3660 “D” Street, La Verne, CA 91750

Attendance and participation at the City of La Verne Planning Commission meetings are welcomed and
appreciated. Community engagement provides the Planning Commission with valuable information. Regular
Meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month. In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any
person with a disability who requires a modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the City Clerk’s Office at (909) 596-8726 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

The Council Chambers will be open to the public at 6:00 p.m. Materials related to an item on this agenda,
submitted to the Planning Commission after distribution of the agenda packet, are available for public
inspection at the meeting or in the Community Development Department during normal business hours.

  CALL TO ORDER

  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  ROLL CALL

  PUBLIC COMMENT

  This is the time set aside for anyone wishing to address the Planning Commission on
  items not listed in any other place on this agenda.

  California Law does not allow the Planning Commission to take action in response to
  your statements at this meeting. Your concerns may be referred to staff or set for

   CITY OF LA VERNE
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  Wednesday, January 11, 2023

1.  Chairperson Simison called the meeting of the La Verne Planning
  Commission to order at 6:30 p.m.

2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  City Attorney Kim Hall Barlow led the Pledge of Allegiance.

3.  ROLL CALL: Planning Commissioners present: Jeffry Allred, Thomas
  Allison, Jason Lorge and Jason Simison. Planning Commissioners not
  present: Jeremy Conrad. Advisory personnel present: Community
  Development Director Eric Scherer, City Attorney Kim Hall Barlow, and
  Assistant Planner Parker Stringfellow.

4.  MINUTES – November 2, 2022

  It was moved by Commissioner Allison and seconded by Commissioner
  Allred to approve the minutes of the November 2, 2022 meeting. Motion
  carried by a 4-0 vote.

5.  PUBLIC COMMENT

  None

PUBLIC HEARINGS

6.  CASE NOS. 122-22CUP, 123-22PPR AND 140-22VAR; 2095 FOOTHILL
  BOULEVARD – APPLICATION TO CONSTRUCT A NEW MONOPOLE
  (MONO-EUCALYPTUS TREE) BEHIND THE EXISTING BUILDING IN
  THE COMMERCIAL EMERALD CENTER (MICHAEL’S/BIG LOTS) AND
  OPERATE A WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATIONS FACILITY –
  CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION FROM CEQA

  RESOLUTION NO. 1300
  A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF
  LA VERNE, COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES STATE OF CALIFORNIA,
  RECOMMENDING APPROVAL OF CASE NOS. 122-22CUP, A
 Planning Commission Minutes
January 11, 2023
  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT AND 140-22VAR, A VARIANCE TO
  ALLOW AN AT&T WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATIONS FACILITY
  LOCATED AT 2095 FOOTHILL BOULEVARD AND FINDING THE
  PROJECT CATEGORICALLY EXEMPT FROM CEQA.

  Assistant Planner Parker Stringfellow presented his staff report. The
  applicant John McDonald of EukonGroup was present at the meeting.

  Chairperson Simison opened the public comment. No comments were
  received.

  Chairperson Simison closed the public comment.

  The Commissioners asked questions regarding noticing, complaints of
  other similar projects, and the size of the tree.

  Mr. Scherer and Mr. Stringfellow addressed the concerns. They stated
  that no complaints were made after the installation of similar monopoles,
  neighbors within a 300-foot radius were notified, and the tree size was
  similar in height to the surrounding trees.

  It was moved by Commissioner Allred and seconded by Mr. Allison to
  approve Case Nos. 122-22CUP and 140-22VAR. Motion carried by a 4-0
  vote.

ADJOURNMENT

  The meeting was adjourned at 6:50 p.m. The next meeting of the Planning
  Commission will be held February 8, 2023 at 6:30 p.m. in the Council
  Chambers, 3660 “D” Street, La Verne, CA 91750.

1  Chairperson Simison called the meeting of the La Verne Planning
  Commission to order at 6:31 p.m.

2.  PLEDGE OFALLEGIANCE

5.  PUBLIC COMMENT

OTHER MATTERS/ INFORMATION

6.  FOOTHILL GOLD LINE UPDATE

  Lisa Levy Buch, Chief Communications Officer and Strategic Development
  Officer of Foothill Gold Line, presented the update. Ms. Levy Buch
  presented the remaining construction timeline and stated that funding is
  still needed to extend the line from Claremont to Montclair.

  The Commissioners had questions regarding traffic signal timing, the
  testing phase of the project, and additional funding for the extension to
  Montclair.
 Planning Commission Minutes
March 8, 2023

  Mr. Scherer stated that the trafiic signal timing would be discussed with
  the City Engineer.

  Ms. Levy Buch anticipates that the line would open for public use in the
  summer or fall of 2025. She is also optimistic funding will be secured for
  the Montclair extension.

7  GENERAL PLAN UPDATE

  Principal Planner Candice Bowcock presented the General Plan Update.

  The Commissioners had questions regarding community outreach and the
  environmental impact on water.

  Mr. Scherer stated that the update will be advertised and promoted on the
  City website and there will be booths at community events.

8.  COMMUNITY DESIGN AWARDS
